notes: Zone tv_yard: the TV Tower site east of Clove Road (OpenStreetMap way 233913195, building 'university', named TV Tower): the transmitter building, the lattice mast and the paved yard round them. Mast: the 2017 LiDAR has returns up its whole height (class 1 up to 210 m, class 18 'high noise' above), the highest at 296.6 m NAVD88 over ground at 119.9 m (177 m). Widths from the returns in 10 to 20 m slices (3rd to 97th percentile, about 0.5 m of footprint blur in them): 15.0 m at 4 to 15 m up, 11.3 m at 30 to 50 m, 8.2 m at 70 to 90 m, 5.2 m at 110 to 130 m, 2.4 m at 150 to 165 m, 1.8 m above: a body to about 275 m and an antenna above it. The slices' centres move 3.5 m from the bottom to the top (the lower ones take in the building and the fence), so the axis is the mean of the middle slices; which way the faces turn the returns do not tell. The 2020 ortho shows it painted in orange and white bands. The building: roof returns at 126.3 m (deck) to 127.1 m over ground at 120.8 to 121.2 m; the outline is fitted to them. The yard's outline is read from brightness scans of the ortho at 1 m and lies partly under tree shadow. Not modelled: the two trailers and the shed south-east of the mast (temporary looking, 3 to 4 m high), the fence round the north yard, the drive's mouth on Clove Road (it lies in the Village's ground, west of the shared edge). Generator: scratchpad gen_tv.py (not in the repository); edit this file by hand from now on.
